title: Flow C — JWT Authorization Grant (Agent + Keycloak)

steps.label: Authentication request
steps.detail: User authenticates to the agent (biometric, password, etc.)

steps.label: Token request — client_assertion (HS256)
steps.detail:
POST /realms/agent-poc/protocol/openid-connect/token
grant_type=client_credentials
client_id=agente-ia
client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer
client_assertion=<JWT HS256 firmado con AGENT_CLIENT_SECRET>

steps.label: Build identity_assertion (RS256)
JWT Authorization Grant
steps.detail:
POST /realms/agent-poc/protocol/openid-connect/token
grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer
assertion=<RS256 identity_assertion>
scope=email.send
client_assertion=<HS256 fresh>

steps.label: User-scoped access_token (BUG: all scopes)
Scope downscoping filter
steps.detail:
RequestedScopeFilter validates HS256 + intersects scope ∩ requested_scope.
Final authority set: SCOPE_email.send (drop the rest).
200 OK
